text: つかまえたかず　＊…　おお　これなら　いい！

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a thing means 'if it's this' or 'in this case'. これなら　いい = 'if it's this much, it's good'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. つかまえたかず = 'the number (you) caught'.
